releases.title: Windows and usability improvements
changes: Improved the PandD logo display in Windows Explorer and the taskbar.
Improved Start menu registration so the launcher can be pinned.
Improved sidebar selection animation performance while game images load.

Unified the Windows application icon with the PandD logo.
